---
title: "Time Series Analysis with Python"
---

*A comprehensive guide to time series analysis, forecasting, and temporal machine learning using Python.*

---

## Welcome

This project is a long-term educational resource dedicated to learning and applying **time series analysis with Python**.

Rather than focusing solely on forecasting, the goal is to develop a deep understanding of temporal data through statistical modeling, machine learning, and modern deep learning techniques.

The project combines theoretical foundations, practical implementations, visual intuition, and real-world case studies into a cohesive learning experience.

---

## Project Goals

The repository aims to:

- Teach time series analysis from first principles.
- Build intuition alongside mathematical rigor.
- Explore classical statistical methods and modern machine learning techniques.
- Develop reusable Python tools.
- Demonstrate complete end-to-end workflows.
- Serve as both an educational resource and a professional portfolio project.

---

## Planned Curriculum

The project is organized into nine major sections.

| Part | Topic |
|------|-------|
| I | Foundations |
| II | Exploratory Time Series Analysis |
| III | Statistical Foundations |
| IV | Classical Forecasting Models |
| V | Feature Engineering |
| VI | Machine Learning |
| VII | Deep Learning |
| VIII | Model Evaluation |
| IX | Case Studies |

---

## Repository

The repository contains:

- Educational notebooks
- Reusable Python package (`ts`)
- Real-world datasets
- End-to-end projects
- Interactive Quarto website
- Unit tests
- Reproducible workflows

---

## Current Status

The project is currently under active development.

The initial phase focuses on building the website infrastructure, reusable utilities, and the foundational chapters before expanding into forecasting models and advanced applications.

---

## Roadmap

The long-term vision is to create a comprehensive reference covering:

- Statistical time series analysis
- Forecasting
- Machine learning
- Deep learning
- Model evaluation
- Real-world applications

As the project evolves, new chapters and case studies will be added to continually expand the scope of the material.
